non_blocking_observations: The benchmark has strong coverage of temporal, precedence, exception, regional, workflow, and multi-hop behavior.
Only a small subset of questions directly stress graph/structured representations; this is acceptable for a shared benchmark, but those queries should be highlighted in the demo.
Exact-value questions are intentionally useful as baseline retrieval tests; they should not be treated as evidence that one representation is universally better.
